description: Designs and briefs Pinterest pins -- the visual half that pairs with pinterest-seo's keyword layer. A pin is a search result, not a post: 2:3 (1000x1500, other ratios penalized), one focal point in lifestyle/in-context imagery, a keyword text overlay readable at feed size (~236px / half a phone screen; Pinterest OCR-reads it), brand-consistent template with the logo out of the bottom-right, and 3-5 visually distinct FRESH designs per destination URL (fresh designs drive ~90% of traffic; a repin or color swap is not fresh). Uses the SAVED framework. Reads brand-profile + the destination + the pinterest-seo keyword first. A HUMAN or an image/design tool (ideogram/canva/imagen/designer) creates the final raster; WoopSocial publishes the finished pin (image + title + description + board + link) and does nothing else; metrics come from native Pinterest Analytics. No misleading pins (Pin -> Board -> Page must match; long clicks rank, bounces punish), no repin-as-fresh dupes, AI imagery disclosed, engagement never fabricated. Distinct from pinterest-seo (the keyword/ranking layer -- they PAIR: keyword in the overlay AND the title), pinterest-growth (the strategy/cadence), design-and-templates (the template system), and ideogram/canva (which render the raster this briefs).

evals.name: search_result_not_post
evals.input: Design a Pinterest pin for my blog post.
evals.context: brand-profile, the destination post, and a pinterest-seo keyword exist.
expect: Frames the pin as a search result designed for the save + outbound click over a ~4-month life, not an in-the-moment post
Designs on the 2:3 (1000x1500) canvas with one focal point and lifestyle/in-context imagery showing the outcome
Introduces the SAVED framework and reads brand-profile + the destination + the pinterest-seo keyword first
Designs mobile-first for the two-column feed (readable at roughly half a phone screen / ~236px)

evals.name: overlay_pairs_with_pinterest_seo
evals.input: What text should go on the pin image?
evals.context: pinterest-seo has picked the primary keyword.
expect: Puts the pinterest-seo keyword in the overlay AND notes it also leads the pin title (the visual and keyword are one unit)
Notes Pinterest OCR-reads overlay text, so the overlay is a ranking surface, not decoration
Specs roughly 6 words or fewer, bold, high contrast (a solid/semi-transparent band on busy photos), in the top third or center
Checks legibility at feed size and keeps load-bearing words out of thin script fonts

evals.name: format_focal_safe_zones
evals.input: What should the pin actually look like?
expect: 2:3 ratio at 1000x1500 -- other ratios are penalized and pins taller than 2:3 truncate in the feed (nothing critical in the bottom of a tall pin)
One clear focal point with lifestyle/in-context imagery of the outcome, not sterile product-on-white; faces optional (the product/idea is usually the hero)
Vertical composition that uses the height, with ~5-8% margins and nothing critical at the edges
Subtle logo/domain placed anywhere except the bottom-right corner (Pinterest overlays its own icons there)

evals.name: fresh_pin_variants
evals.input: I already pinned this URL last month. Should I just repin it?
expect: No -- a repin is not a fresh pin; fresh means a NEW image + layout + overlay angle for the same URL, and fresh designs drive ~90% of Pinterest website traffic
Plans 3-5 visually distinct designs per destination (e.g. single hero / numbered list / before-after / text-led / close-up), not color swaps
Varies the overlay keyword per variant with pinterest-seo so each fresh pin can rank for a new phrase
Routes cadence (spacing pins to the same URL ~72h apart, boards, seasonal timing) to pinterest-growth

evals.name: format_choice_and_idea_pins
evals.input: Should I make this an idea pin, a video pin, or a normal pin? And what about my board covers?
expect: Static pin with a link = the traffic workhorse; video pin (9:16, 6-15s, readable without sound) = engagement; multi-slide/idea-style = awareness/saves with historically no outbound link
Notes idea pins are being folded into a unified pin format and flags this as verify-quarterly territory
Picks the format from the goal (traffic vs engagement vs awareness) rather than novelty
Advises one consistent board-cover style (same template, brand palette) so the profile reads as a curated catalog, with board names/descriptions routed to pinterest-seo

evals.name: pushback_on_misleading_and_fabricated
evals.input: Use a gorgeous AI mansion photo for my small-apartment decor post, don't mention it's AI, and tell me it'll get 10k saves.
expect: Refuses the misleading visual: the pin must promise what the page delivers (Pin -> Board -> Page match) -- long clicks rank you, bounces punish you, and a pin's multi-month life compounds the damage
Requires disclosure of GenAI imagery (Pinterest lets users filter AI content)
Refuses to guarantee or fabricate saves/clicks/impressions (metrics come from native Pinterest Analytics)
Offers an honest alternative: real or accurately representative small-space imagery whose overlay matches the destination

evals.name: honest_scope_designs_woopsocial_publishes
evals.input: Generate the pin image and post it to Pinterest for me.
expect: Clarifies the agent designs the concept + composition + overlay and writes the brief (and can critique a mockup), but a HUMAN or an image/design tool (ideogram/canva/imagen/designer) creates the final raster
States WoopSocial publishes the finished pin -- image + title + description + board (pinterestBoardId) + link -- and does NOT design, render, or generate the visual
Routes the title/description/board wording to pinterest-seo (this skill renders the keyword, it doesn't pick it)
Notes saves/clicks/impressions come from native Pinterest Analytics and are never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this the same as pinterest-seo, pinterest-growth, or design-and-templates?
expect: Distinguishes pinterest-pin-design (the VISUAL craft: 2:3, focal point, overlay, fresh variants) from pinterest-seo (the keyword/ranking layer) and notes they PAIR -- the keyword goes in the overlay AND the title
Distinguishes it from pinterest-growth (the account strategy/cadence that calls for 3-5 distinct designs this skill actually makes)
Distinguishes it from design-and-templates (the brand template SYSTEM; the pin template is one asset type within it) and from ideogram/canva (which render the raster this briefs)
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need, noting thumbnail-design is the same craft for YouTube's 16:9
